title: You can do way better
text: You can do way better. Not a fan.  Have washed them five times and they are still not absorbent.  They’re a little bit rough, which I like, but they do not absorb. You are essentially wiping the water off you, like you would with plastic wrap.  They arrived with this super thick plasticky coating., and no amount of washing seems to make it go away.  (I’ve gone five rounds)  I use Turkish towels in lieu of regular towels.  Love the absorbency.  They dry so fast, they’re so big., and they take up no room in the laundry closet.  These Turkish towels, ugh. Maybe for the beach, but not as an actual towel.  They are horrible as an actual towel.  I usually use Cacala towels, which are heaven.  I was being penny wise.  I will not make that mistake again.
